next.reason: 1985: "may be specified only for a numeric data description entry whose PICTURE contains the character 'S'"; 2023: "— an alphanumeric group item, national group item, or strongly-typed group item.". 2023 keeps numeric report group entries with 'S' but also allows SIGN on group items, with no exception for the report section; the 1985 Report Writer rule allowed numeric entries only.
